plain.li: Another year on the rim, and most of us are still here.
The seed for spring is sorted and dry. Whatever else next year brings, we'll plant.
[annals:losses] Their names are written above. Someone should cut them in stone as well, where they'll outlast this page.
[annals:violent] We slept with our weapons by the bed for most of this year. I would like to put them away for a while.
[annals:peaceful] A quiet year. The walls went months without needing a single repair.
[annals:richer] We have more than we did a year ago, and raiders will have heard. Keep the walls in good repair.
[annals:growing] More mouths to feed and more hands to work. There's a queue for the stew pot now.
[winter] It's snowing as I write this, and the ink keeps thickening in the cold.

warm.li: Whatever next year brings, I'd rather meet it with this lot than with anyone else.
[annals:losses] Some nights I still set out too many bowls.
[annals:growing] Supper is louder now, with all the new faces. I hope they've begun to feel at home here.

blunt.li: That's the year. Most of it was mud and hard work.
[annals:violent] They kept coming, and we kept digging graves for them.
[annals:peaceful] Nothing tried to kill us this year. Keep your weapons within reach anyway.

cheerful.li: What a year! I've filled more pages than I ever thought I would.
[annals:richer] We're richer than we've ever been! I say we spend some of it on a proper feast.
[annals:peaceful] Hardly a raid all year! I've underlined that twice.

gloomy.li: Another year gone. We got through it, which is more than I expected in the spring.
[annals:losses] Some of the names at the front of this book won't be in the next one.
[annals:violent] The raids run together when I try to remember them. After each one I counted heads.

cold.li: That concludes the year. Survival rate acceptable.
[annals:losses] Losses were within expectations. Replace them.
[annals:richer] Our wealth grew this year, and the raids will grow in proportion.
